## Gaps to fix

1. **[high] loading-states** — Stage 'loading' lacks Skeleton component. The component sets stage to 'loading' but the UI implementation is truncated—there must be a visible loading state that should use <Skeleton /> rather than spinner or text alone per design system.
   Fix: Import Skeleton from '@/components/ui/skeleton' and render a structured skeleton layout during 'loading' stage that matches the final UI shape (e.g., <Skeleton className='h-24 w-full' /> for transcript area, <Skeleton className='h-10 w-32' /> for buttons).
   Where: src/components/atlas-plan/PhaseWizard.tsx

2. **[high] accessibility** — The transcript scrolling div (transcriptRef) with auto-scroll behavior lacks aria-live region announcement. Users with screen readers won't be notified of new wizard turns appearing dynamically. The useEffect at line ~172 performs silent DOM scrolling.
   Fix: Add aria-live='polite' and aria-atomic='false' to the transcript container div. For turn-by-turn updates, wrap each new question in an element with role='status' so screen readers announce them.
   Where: src/components/atlas-plan/PhaseWizard.tsx:172

3. **[high] accessibility** — Dialog lacks accessible description of wizard state. The DialogDescription should dynamically reflect current stage (loading/turns/preview/error) and turn count (e.g., 'Turn 3 of 12') for screen reader users.
   Fix: Make DialogDescription dynamic: {stage === 'turns' && `Question ${state?.history.length ?? 0} of ${MAX_WIZARD_TURNS}`} {stage === 'loading' && 'Initializing wizard...'} etc.
   Where: src/components/atlas-plan/PhaseWizard.tsx

4. **[high] states** — Input field for pendingFreeText (likely a textarea for wizard answers) is not visible in truncated code but must have :focus-visible ring-2 ring-emerald-600/50 per design system. The setPendingFreeText state setter at line 116 implies an uncontrolled input.
   Fix: Ensure the textarea/input for free-text answers includes className with 'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-600/50 focus-visible:ring-offset-2' and uses <Label htmlFor='...'> pairing.
   Where: src/components/atlas-plan/PhaseWizard.tsx:116

5. **[medium] accessibility** — Buttons using icon-only (Wand2, Check, X, MessageSquare, Send from lucide-react imports) must have aria-label. The imports at lines 2-3 suggest icon-only buttons but no aria-label attributes are visible in truncated code.
   Fix: Add aria-label to all icon-only buttons: <Button aria-label='Start wizard'><Wand2 /></Button>, <Button aria-label='Confirm'><Check /></Button>, etc.
   Where: src/components/atlas-plan/PhaseWizard.tsx:2

6. **[medium] mobile-responsive** — Dialog with multi-turn conversational UI likely has tall transcript div. Must ensure touch targets are min-h-[44px] for answer buttons/options and bottom padding pb-4 minimum for safe-area on mobile.
   Fix: Add min-h-[44px] to all interactive elements (answer buttons, send button). Add pb-4 or pb-safe to DialogFooter. Use max-h-[60vh] md:max-h-[70vh] on transcript container with overflow-y-auto.
   Where: src/components/atlas-plan/PhaseWizard.tsx

7. **[medium] design-tokens** — Clarity score visualization (line 183: 'const clarity = state?.clarity_score ?? 0') likely renders a progress indicator. Must use emerald-600 for score bars/good states, amber-500 for medium, red-600 for low—never hex literals.
   Fix: If rendering a progress bar or badge for clarity score, use conditional Tailwind classes: {clarity > 0.7 ? 'bg-emerald-600' : clarity > 0.4 ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-red-600'}. Never use style={{backgroundColor: '#...'}}.
   Where: src/components/atlas-plan/PhaseWizard.tsx:183

8. **[low] hierarchy** — DialogTitle will render the wizard title. Ensure only one H1 per page—DialogTitle should be H2 (verify shadcn Dialog default), and if phase title is displayed inside, it should be H3 (text-lg).
   Fix: Verify DialogTitle renders as <h2>. If displaying parentTitle inside dialog body, wrap in <h3 className='text-lg font-medium'>.
   Where: src/components/atlas-plan/PhaseWizard.tsx
